statement: HBM supply remains concentrated in two Korean vendors: per Counterpoint data cited in the article, SK Hynix held 50% and Samsung 32% of the Q2 2026 HBM market versus Micron's 18%.
why: When over 80% of HBM sits with two suppliers, accelerator makers carry concentrated supplier risk and limited pricing leverage.

impact.mechanism: A concentrated HBM supplier base means any single-vendor yield or allocation shock propagates directly into merchant GPU and ASIC build plans.

evidence.excerpt: SK Hynix ranked first in the global HBM market in the second quarter of this year with a 50% market share, Samsung Electronics held 32%, while Micron accounted for 18%.

confidence.basis: Third-party research figures relayed by a single secondary outlet; not a filing.
